check.description: Typecheck — catches contract breaks a lane cannot see (~3s)

promote.//: `unit` is the whole suite (~11s). It was defined and never gated anything: promote required `smoke`, a SINGLE test file, which cannot see a type break, a signature regression, or red tests elsewhere. A handoff reporting '175 tests, all passing' was true of its subset while the suite had 21 red. Gate on the whole thing; `smoke` is redundant under `unit`.
